alvium_1800_u500m_open_housing_c_mount.pick_reason: Bare board has no lens mount and needs an S-mount holder; open housing C-mount gives a fixed sensor-to-flange alignment and the C-mount lens market for 45 g, no tight mass budget on LR Mate. Closed housing adds 15 g and heat-sinking but not needed.
alvium_1800_u500m_open_housing_c_mount.caution: Rolling shutter: image skew if the wrist moves during exposure; use short strobed exposure with the arm stopped or the blue strobe.
